text: Doesn’t matter if we win or lose...\nLet’s just have fun!
I might be young, but I hope you won’t hold that\nagainst me.
I’m not like all the rest of those youngsters\nyou might’ve battled till now!
Deep breath in, and...deep breath out...\nNo, wait—I’m still not ready for this!
I’m gonna do this! I’m gonna take you on!\nI’m gonna hold nothing back!
Well, look at you...\nI think I could go all out if it were against you.
Watch as I show you what my studies have\ntaught me!
I’m the president of my school’s Pokémon club!
If I keep making my opponent’s Pokémon flinch,\nthen it’s like my turn never ever ends!
Crumbs, y-you look strong...\nI’m not sure I’m up for this...
Oh my word, it’s been AGES since I last saw you!\nHow’ve you been doing?!
Let’s battle to decide which one of us has\nthe cutest Pokémon!
Pika pika?
I can relax the best when I’m dressed up like\na Pikachu.
Guess what! Guess what!\nFolks are always telling me my team’s real strong!
I’m going to use my Veevee power to make you\ncry wee, wee, wee all the way home!
I was out playing, and I ended up wandering in\nhere by mistake!
I’m here in my jam jams!\nGuess I’ll battle in jam jams!
I don’t go easy on anyone. Not even on children.
I’ve just popped over for a battle during my\nbreak time, so let’s make this quick!
Here, let me give you my card...\nWhat, you don’t have a business card?
I take all the stress I’ve built up in my workplace\nand blast it all away with a good battle!
Time to leverage my core competencies!\nI’ve got buy-in from all my Pokémon!
I wish I could get paid just for battling Pokémon...
You’re the Champion, aren’t you?!\nC-could I get your autograph?
My shorts are from Jetsetter.\nIt’s a famous brand, I’ll have you know.
Show my Pokémon a bit of love, won’t you?
Ah... That’s it! I’ve decided! If I win this match,\nI’m going to tell my crush exactly how I feel!
Statistically speaking, the odds are 95 percent\ncertain that I’ll win!
Do your best in this battle!\n’Cause I’m live streaming it all, see!
... ... ...\nYou gonna start this or what?
If I’m good at Pokémon battles, I’ll be popular!
It’s not just a costume!\nI really am a Pokémon!
Nice to meetcha, pika!\nWant a battle, pika pika?
Pokémon with Hidden Abilities are hard to find\nin the wild, but guess who got lucky?
Your Pokémon shall be my Pokémon’s playthings!
If I had to rank my strength, I’d say it’s...\nat the lower end of average.
I don’t get enough exercise in my daily life,\nso I’m here to do some Pokémon battling!
Let’s make this a real flashy battle worth posting\non all my feeds, OK?
Want to know what kind of work I do around\nthe office?
Pokémon Breeders have to be early risers!
Pokémon that are hatched from Eggs may know\nunusual moves!
It’s love that makes me raise them...\nAnd love that makes me battle with them.
All right there?\nI’m a new Breeder! Charmed, I’m sure!
Safety first!\nThen Poké Ball second!
Have you been enjoying riding on the trains that\nI bust my butt to maintain?!
When it comes to battle, my Pokémon have got\nthe heart to take part! Have you?!
I’ve got a doctor’s note. I can’t be expected to\nlift anything heavier than a Poké Ball...
You...you smell strong to me.\nOr at least like you haven’t showered in a while.
I’ve been training myself up through an online\nkarate class! Hiyah!
I’ve been living alone up in the mountains and\ntraining my Pokémon without distraction!
You can see it, can’t you?\nHow positively cut my six-pack is?
Huh? What’s going on?\nAre we supposed to battle now or something?
The people in Galar are all so nice!\nAre you?
I’m off duty today, mate. I’ll not be hearing any\nof that “the customer is always right” rubbish!
Where to, guv?
The true heart of fishing is being able to wait!\nAnd wait...and wait...and wait...
Fancy a spot of fishing?\nI love me a good bit of fishing.
Hrmmm?! You look right suspicious to me!\nI think I’ll have to take you in for questioning!
I’m not skiving off work—I swear it!\nThis tower is a part of my regular patrol beat!
I’m the living proof that there’s no reason you\ncan’t be both beautiful and strong! Watch this!
I’m a star on and off the runway.\nNow see how I shine.
How about a double shot...\nof defeat?!
I bring richness and depth to everything I do,\nwhether its brewing a drink or battling Pokémon!
I come from one of the great noble houses of\nthe Galar region.
I am here to evaluate the quality of your team,\nboth in terms of strength and appearance.
My Pokémon are as strong as anything!\nWe’re gonna show you, you young thing!
All right! I’m up for a battle with you!\nLet’s get this place...ROCKING!
The Pokémon are the lead performers!\nI’m just a backup dancer!
Let’s dance!
It’s pretty tough going once you reach this level.\nNot many make it higher than this.
No WAY! You’re the Champion! Get out!!\nThis is, like, the greatest day of my life!
I’m here taking part in the Battle Tower together\nwith my girlfriend!
I’m here taking part in the Battle Tower together\nwith my boyfriend!
I might look like a Pokémon, but don’t you dare\nhit me with any of your moves!
Kneel down before me!
They said I had to come battle here as part of my\nnew-hire orientation, that’s all...
I AM A ROBOT IN HUMAN APPEARANCE.\nI WILL DEEPEN MY TIES WITH POKÉMON.
Are you raising your Pokémon?\nOr are you not?
My babies are all frightfully cute!
Feast your eyes on the muscles I’ve developed\ndoing years of hard construction labor!
All right, pack it in!\nLet’s get this battle over and done with!
I joined up as part of the League staff because\nI heard I’d be popular that way!
People say I seem harsh, but I’m really very nice!
Let’s begin the operation...\nScalpel, please.
What’s this?\nYou’d like me to examine your Pokémon?
Battle is like art in so many ways!\nBut art is completely different than battle!
Hehe! Well, aren’t you a cute little thing I get\nto take on in battle! ♪
I shall show you how a true gentleman battles.
Well, have a look at you! You are the spitting\nimage of my grandchildren, dear.
Student and Trainer!\nI’ve got many hats to wear, all right?!
I never fit in with the others at school.\nThis is the only place I really belong!
No one in my class offers me any challenge.\nI wonder if you’ll be any different?
Don’t you dare think I’ll be an easy pushover just\nbecause I’m still a child!
I’m gonna come at you like whoa, then bam,\nand you’re gonna totally be like “whaaat!”
Battling and winning...\nTell me—what does it all mean?
When I grow up, my dream is to be Champion!
I’ve waited 20 years for this day to come!
It’s important you don’t neglect all the routine\ntasks, whether it’s for work or training Pokémon.
I got off at the wrong stop on the monorail and\nsomehow ended up at the Battle Tower.
Eek!\nY-you weren’t watching me just now, right?!
I won’t raise any Pokémon that don’t have\nadorable backsides to watch in battle!
Hm? I think I’ve seen you at the station.
Mind the gap between yourself and victory.\nMind the gap.
It’s mighty strange, but for some reason, folk oft\nseem to feel poorly after eating my cooking.
Pokémon that have been carefully seasoned\nwith the perfect amount of training... Masterful!
I’m a wandering day laborer. I go where my heart\nleads, then dig, dig, dig till I can’t dig no more.
Hope you’re ready for some hard hits!\nThe right moves take weight into consideration!
I’d meant to become a flower arranger,\nbut I ended up as a boilermaker!
My helmet’s as durable as my Pokémon!
I’m going to hit your Pokémon right where it\nhurts! This’ll be a critical battle!
I’m sleepy... This is such a pain...\nI didn’t sleep but two hours last night!
When you do this job long enough, you develop\na knack for telling who’s strong at a glance.
Truth is, I’d rather just be at home, relaxing\nand vegging out with my Pokémon...
“A Serious Battle”—scene one, take one!\nThree, two, one, and...action!
I’m gonna film you so up close and personal,\nyour pores are gonna be famous!
Hah...hah... I...I battled all the way here just\nto get an exclusive interview with you!
I’m live on the scene here at the Battle Tower!\nWhat a sight! You getting this back in the studio?
I’ve heard that Pokémon battling can be a pretty\ngood workout.
Join the legions of my fans!
They call me the connoisseur of moves!
I often see you coming round to the Pokémon\nCenter for a bit of care.
Here I am out on my journey, and I meet you!
Don’t blow my cover! I’m part of the International\nPolice, here on a lead about a certain case!
You’re coming to my gig tonight, right?\nYou’ll buy tickets, right?
People always seemed shocked to find out I’m an\nopera singer. Guess it must be my face...
There’s one thing you really need for battle...\nA killer sense of rhythm!
It’s been three years since I left home to become\na star! I’m not going back till I’ve made it!
You look like a strong one!\nEver thought of joining the force?
I was a real bad seed when I was young.\nEverybody feared me in the neighborhood.
Can we get this over with?\nI’m due for a yoga class soon!
I nip my competition in the bud before it has the\nchance to grow. That’s how I’ve made it this far.
B-blimey but I’m nervous...\nPlease be kind!
My shorts are the perfect fit!\nThat means I can’t lose!
I’ve got a test tomorrow that I should be revising\nfor, but I came for a battle instead!
Can you hear me? I’m talking directly to your\nmind right now.
Postal delivery! I’ve got a parcel here with your\nname on it. Oh, look. The contents say “defeat.”
I’ll walk all over you with the well-developed\ncalves I got from years of making deliveries!
When I wear a surgical mask, it makes my glasses\nfog up!
Steady on. You don’t look very well.\nI think what you need is a jab.
People call me “the angel in the white coat.”\nJust thought I’d mention it.
RKS Laboratories is like a home to me.\nI work such long hours, I rarely see my real one...
I’ve got you covered. Just say the place,\nand I’ll have you there in a heartbeat.
My top priority is your safety and comfort.\nWhich is why I expect you’ll pay extra, eh?
Body temperature and weight are both right\non track! These Pokémon are in top condition!
Oh-ho? Now this is a promising specimen!\nI’d definitely like to see more!
Come on! No grumbling accepted here.\nLet’s let our Pokémon do the talking!
What would you say your training style is?\nGenerous and openhanded? Or maybe spartan?
I’ve grown so weary of all the world’s pleasures.\nNow all I do from dawn to dusk is battle wildly.
Why don’t I give you the chance to see the\nPokémon I’ve spent a fortune raising!
My children have all grown and left home.\nNow I’m embarking on a new life of my own!
I heard the other ladies at the club saying that\nPokémon were quite the thing, so here I am.
Heh! If you want to know what moves my\nPokémon use, you’re about to learn firsthand!
*scritch scritch scritch* Wood carving...\n*scritch scritch scritch* It’s so zen...
After years and years of training, I’ve finally\nmanaged to obtain the ultimate moves!
Wot’s this? You my next victim?
Be a good sport.\nLet’s have a fair-and-square battle.
Being able to read a Pokémon’s mind...\nThat’s the real trick to fishing.
I’m in the market for a fishing buddy!\nHow about you? Care to go fish with me?
Life’s got its mountains and its valleys.\nJust like this tower’s got its highs and lows!
I love climbing up to the top, and I love\ntumbling down to the bottom, too!
I’ve filled myself with the great power of\nboundless nature!
All right, there? You strong or what?\nI’m gonna expect a good battle, yeah?
I-if I win, would you help me get a hotel room\nfor tonight? I’m so tired of camping...
The battle’s not over until it’s over.\nDon’t let your focus slip!
Winning and losing aren’t as important to me\nas having a right good time!
I battled and battled and battled...\nAll to be standing right here!
Hahaha! Think you can show me a fun time?
I’ve left behind my family, my friends—everything.\nThe only thing for me is this—the battlefield.
Think you can keep up with the spweed at which\nI ewolve and change?
Our department takes a real hard-line stance.\nNo lenience for juveniles!
My boyfriend broke my heart...\nNow I’m ready to break yours!

This team is good for Single Battles!
It’s a nice, simple team that’s built around three
Pokémon close to the heart of anyone in Galar.\c
Take a good hard look at what types of Pokémon
your opponent is sending out, then choose one
of these great allies to send out yourself!

This team is good for Single Battles!
The Pokémon on this team know tons of moves
that can help them boost their stats in battle.\c
Send out Duraludon first and have it use Reflect
or Light Screen to get a defensive advantage,
then swap in others as fit for the situation!

This team is good for Single Battles!
This almighty team is ready for any opponents.\c
Of course they can unleash heavy hit after heavy
hit, but if you also use their status moves wisely,
then you might even be able to pull out a win
against opponents that might usually put you in
a real sticky situation!

This rain-ready team is good for Double Battles!\c
Falling rain can boost the power of their moves
or trigger certain Abilities, so start by sending
out Pelipper first to get the rain going and get\c
this team rolling!

This team is good for Double Battles!
They might look real slow to start with, but all
you need is a good Trick Room, and suddenly
your slow bulky team will be a fast bulky team!\c
Lucario will be great support if you know how to
use it, so hurry straight into a Trick Room!
